notes.title: Developer playing the game!
notes.content: [p]Our team is playing the game so you guys can see how it looks before the release![/p]

notes.title: Casual Sport Series: Badminton is here! Play Demo now!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We're proud to announce that our game Casual Sport Series: Badminton is very close to release on Steam! 
We are part of this year's Steam's next fest, and we released demo version of our game so you can play it before buying our game to see if it works for you. 

We would love to gather some feedback from you guys so we can improve our game, so if you feel like you can help us improve our game, feel free to contact us over here in community threads, or you could join our Discord so we could talk more about it.
